meta.title: Software Outsourcing Vietnam, Devs from $300 | Cross Tech Edu
meta.description: Cross Tech Edu is a Hanoi-based software outsourcing company: web, mobile, backend, cloud and AI. Developers from 300 USD/month, 12-month warranty.

data.title: Your engineering team, based in Vietnam.
data.lead: Cross Tech Edu delivers outsourced web, mobile, backend and cloud work for clients in Japan, Korea and Europe. Delivery in two-week sprints, contracts with no minimum term.
data.sub: Đội ngũ kỹ thuật của bạn, đặt tại Việt Nam — web, mobile, backend và cloud, bàn giao theo sprint 2 tuần.

rate.label: Developer rate
rate.note: The lowest starting rate in the Vietnamese market. Full-time 160 hours, with PM and QA included free from 3 developers.

stats.label: Until your first MVP is in your hands
Specialist team, one codebase for 2+ platforms

data.title: Nine things we do, and nothing more.
data.intro: Each area has a fixed team and its own review process. Hire by the person or by the whole project — either way you work with the same team.

items.title: Web development
items.body: Next.js, React, Laravel. From company websites to internal systems with many roles.

items.title: Mobile app
items.body: Flutter and React Native. One codebase for iOS and Android, and we publish to the stores for you.

items.title: Backend & API
items.body: Node, Go, .NET, PostgreSQL. REST and GraphQL, with API documentation delivered.

items.title: UI/UX design
items.body: Figma, design systems, clickable prototypes before the first line of code.

items.title: QA / Testing
items.body: Manual and automated tests that block merges until they pass. A report every sprint.

items.title: DevOps & Cloud
items.body: AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes. CI/CD, monitoring and infrastructure cost optimisation.

items.title: AI / Data
items.body: LLM integration, RAG over your internal data, data pipelines and reporting dashboards.

items.title: Dedicated team
items.body: Monthly staffing that you manage directly, working in your time zone.

items.title: Maintenance & support
items.body: 4-hour response SLA, same-day hotfixes, 24/7 on-call for production systems.

data.title: The most optimized prices for SMEs, published on this page.
data.intro: No hidden tiers, no setup fee, no management fee. A detailed quote within 48 hours of receiving your requirements.

data.title: From the first email to production: five steps.

steps.title: Consultation & quote
steps.body: You send your requirements; we ask exactly what we need to lock the scope.

steps.title: Scope & contract
steps.body: Features, delivery milestones and payment terms are written down before we start.

steps.title: Two-week sprints
steps.body: Every sprint ends with a working build on your staging environment.

steps.title: QA & handover
steps.body: Regression tests, API docs, source code and infrastructure access handed over to you.

steps.title: Warranty & operations
steps.body: Free bug fixes for 12 months; 24/7 operations is a separate plan if you need it.

data.title: Send your brief, get a quote in 48 hours.
data.body: Include a product description, your target timeline and expected budget — we reply with a concrete scope and price, not a sales email.
